name: 16483-solodecode-minimaxm21-tp8
model: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.1. Not substitutable. 230.2 GB of safetensors over 152 files, ungated, not in the local HF cache.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, ONE node (--gres=gpu:8), NVLink/NVSwitch across all eight.
parallelism: TP=8 with EP=8, PP=1, DP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier. EP=8 is mandatory, not a tuning choice: at plain MoE-TP 8 the FP8 quantization block does not divide the per-rank expert width and the server refuses to start. See sglang-config.yaml.
architecture: MiniMaxM2ForCausalLM, 62 layers, hidden 3072, 48 attention heads over 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, 256 routed experts top-8 at intermediate_size 1536, block-wise FP8 with weight_block_size [128, 128]; ~230B parameters total, ~10B active per token, 28.8 GB of weights per card at eight-way sharding.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 48 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, of which 36 are measured.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, SINGLE TURN, no prefix buckets: prompts drawn around 1536 tokens (stdev 384, clipped to [768, 2560]) and outputs around 1024 (stdev 256, clipped to [512, 1536]). ignore_eos true, temperature 0.0, seed 42.
purpose: A single-user coding assistant on a large mixture-of-experts model, answering one long prompt at a time across eight GPUs.
launch:
# ENGINE: sglang at commit 9c168fcac7f6200d9584ea9a60ee45ce3ac0cc14. A commit, not a release, so
#   the interpreter is named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`.
# Nothing here is tuned: the engine's own published 8-GPU recipe for this checkpoint minus what
#   the harness owns (host, port, served-model-name). Everything not stated is a stock default.

model-path: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.1

tp-size: 8

# MANDATORY, not a tuning choice. Expert width is 1536 and the FP8 quantization block is 128
# wide; under plain MoE tensor parallelism each rank would hold 1536/8 = 192 columns and
# 192 % 128 = 64, which `Fp8MoEMethod.create_weights` rejects with a hard ValueError before the
# first token -- the server does not start at all. At ep-size 8 each rank holds whole experts.
ep-size: 8

# The checkpoint ships an auto_map and its own tokenizer files; without this it will not load.
trust-remote-code: true

# 0.85 of each card, the recipe's own value.
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
